title: Neon Drift
logline: Dodge cascading neon obstacles as your ship hurtles through a cyberpunk highway — survive as long as you can while chasing the highest score.
visualStyle: Dark cyberpunk with neon glow effects, grid-line highway, and particle trails. Color palette: deep navy background (#0a0a1a), cyan player (#00ccff), red/orange obstacles, golden collectibles.
coreMechanic: Lane-switching dodge — player taps left/right to snap between 5 lanes, avoiding procedurally spawned obstacles that scroll down at increasing speed. Collecting bonus orbs grants score multipliers.
progression: Difficulty increases continuously — obstacle spawn rate increases, speed rises with score. Every 500 points the speed tier steps up. Every 10 dodged obstacles in a row increases the combo multiplier (max 5x). Bonus orbs appear every 15–25 seconds.
scoring: +10 base points per obstacle dodged (multiplied by combo). +50 for collecting a bonus orb. Combo multiplier resets on hit (if lives remain). High score persisted across sessions.
gameOverCondition: Player collides with an obstacle. Single-life — one hit and it's over.
restartBehavior: Full reset: score to 0, speed to initial, combo to 1x, clear all obstacles and particles, player back to center lane.

screens.intro: Neon title 'NEON DRIFT' with pulsing glow animation centered on screen. Below: logline text. Animated starfield/grid scrolling in background. Control hints at bottom. 'Click to Start' prompt pulsing. Phaser particle emitter for ambient floating particles.
screens.hud: Top-left: Score counter with smooth tween to new value. Below score: current speed multiplier. If combo > 1x, show combo badge with golden glow. Top-right: High score in muted color.
screens.pause: Semi-transparent dark overlay (alpha 0.7) over frozen game. 'PAUSED' text centered with neon glow. Current score displayed. 'Press ESC to Resume' prompt pulsing below.
screens.gameOver: Dark overlay over final frame. 'GAME OVER' in red with dramatic scale-in tween. Final score large and cyan. If new high score: golden 'NEW HIGH SCORE!' with particle celebration. Speed and combo stats. 'Click to Play Again' prompt pulsing.

objects.name: PlayerShip
objects.description: Cyan neon triangle/arrow shape in the center-bottom area. Smooth lerp movement between lanes. Particle trail behind it. Glow effect radius around it.

objects.name: Obstacle
objects.description: Red/orange neon rectangles that fill most of a lane's width. Variable height (30-60px). Spawn at top of screen, scroll down. Glow border with inner accent line. Physics group with object pooling.

objects.name: BonusOrb
objects.description: Golden pulsing circle collectible. Spawns rarely. Scale tween animation (breathing). Particle burst on collection. Worth +50 points.

objects.name: LaneGrid
objects.description: Vertical cyan gridlines marking 5 lanes. Horizontal grid lines scrolling down for speed effect. Low opacity (0.08-0.1).

objects.name: Starfield
objects.description: Background layer of small white/blue dots scrolling down at variable speeds for parallax depth effect.

objects.name: Particles
objects.description: Particle emitters for: player trail (cyan), obstacle explosion on near-miss (orange sparks), orb collection (golden burst), combo milestone (screen-wide cyan flash).
